1.natural_language: Click the conservation patches on the current window to inspect the hidden glass pieces; each exposed piece stays visible when it moves. Restore the thirteen glass pieces to the reference. Start the collars. A disc may turn only when it contains the heart and no foreign point. Turn while its moving notch straddles the fixed brass pin. Turning a free disc against a closed collar cracks the window and ends the episode. Shape-blocked probes are harmless. Collars keep moving during dragging and holding. Seal only the restored window.
